---
title: "July Temperature Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

temp_data <- read_csv("willamette_temp.csv")

```

## July Data

```{r}

july_data <- subset(temp_data, month == "Jul")

```

## GLM Trend Analysis

```{r}

july_model <- glm(
  temp_C ~ year * site_no,
  data = july_data
)

summary(july_model)

```

## Visualization

```{r}

ggplot(july_data,
       aes(x = year,
           y = temp_C,
           color = site_no)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +

  labs(
    title = "July Stream Temperature Trends",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal()

```
